rpc: an Ethereum archive JSON-RPC endpoint; its URL is not recorded
rpc_note: every read is a standard archive method: eth_getLogs of the wiring events from block 0 over the subjects, and of Blue's CreateMarket, EnableIrm, SetOwner and SetFeeRecipient; eth_getStorageAt of the EIP-1967 implementation slot at the pinned block; eth_getCode at the pinned block, at each creation block and the block before; eth_getTransactionByHash, eth_getTransactionReceipt and eth_getBlockByNumber. No trace method is used

G. Morpho-Compound, Morpho-AaveV2 and Morpho-AaveV3: proxies, implementation epochs, managers, lenses and supply vaults
